name: Dynamic Tags for Elementor
author: Mustafa Kamal hossain

sections.description:
Dynamic Tags for Elementor enables 110+ custom dynamic tags in Elementor Free, organized into purpose-built groups:

Post (DTE) — Post title, date, content, categories, comments, and post conditions (Is 404, Is Home, etc).
Archive (DTE) — Archive titles, descriptions, and archive-page URLs.
Site (DTE) — Site title, URL, tagline, and site metadata.
Media (DTE) — Featured images, galleries, site logo and icon.
Author (DTE) — Author name, bio, profile picture, and author URLs.
User (DTE) — Current user ID, display name, email, role, and capabilities.
Actions (DTE) — Dynamic URLs for buttons, links, lightboxes, and off-canvas content.
Comments (DTE) — Comments URL and comment counts.
Taxonomy (DTE) — Current term names, descriptions, and term images.
WooCommerce (DTE) — Product price, SKU, stock status, categories, and ratings.
ACF (DTE) — 13 ACF field tags with multi-format output options.
SCF (DTE) — 13 Secure Custom Fields tags with ACF-compatible APIs.

Use for dynamic text, URLs, images, and conditional outputs in any Elementor Free widget.

See full tag list in the plugin settings page.

Dependencies

  • Required: Elementor
  • Optional: Advanced Custom Fields (ACF), Secure Custom Fields (SCF), WooCommerce, WPML/Polylang
sections.installation:
1. Upload plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/dynamic-tags-for-elementor.
  2. Activate via Plugins menu.
  3. Open Elementor editor → click Dynamic Tags icon on any supported field → choose a tag.

For quick tag discovery, go to WP Admin → Dynamic Tags → Tag Directory.
sections.faq:
Does this require Elementor Pro?

No. This plugin works exclusively with Elementor Free.

Will this conflict with Elementor Pro tags?

No. Elementor Pro and DTE tag groups coexist without conflicts.

Does this support ACF and WooCommerce?

Yes. ACF (13 tags) and WooCommerce (8 tags) integrations are optional and auto-detect based on plugin availability.

What about SCF (Secure Custom Fields)?

Yes. SCF support was added in v1.1.0 with feature parity to ACF.

Where do I report bugs or request features?

Visit the plugin support forum.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Added: Full SCF (Secure Custom Fields) support with 13 parity tags.
  • Added: ACF Field, True/False, Choice, File, Link URL, Link Text, Image Data, and Link Attribute tags for complete ACF coverage.
  • Improved: Reorganized dynamic-tags folder into logical group subdirectories for better maintainability.
  • Enhanced: Free/Pro compatibility layer for robust coexistence.

1.0.9.1

  • Updated: Blueprint for WordPress.org Live Preview support.

See full changelog in changelog.txt.
